items.name: Monolith & Shards
items.cadence_note: one dense analytical block, then three short strikes

items.name: Staircase
items.cadence_note: paragraphs lengthen as the argument deepens

items.name: Inverted Staircase
items.cadence_note: long opening scene tightening to an aphoristic close

items.name: Pendulum
items.cadence_note: thesis work in the long paragraphs, doubt in the short ones

items.name: Twin Peaks
items.cadence_note: two dense blocks separated by a one-or-two-sentence hinge paragraph

items.name: Slow Fuse
items.cadence_note: three even expository paragraphs; all detonation in the last

items.name: Front-Load
items.cadence_note: the hardest analytic work first; consequences cascade after

items.name: Interruption
items.cadence_note: one anomalously short mid-passage paragraph that breaks frame

items.name: Braid
items.cadence_note: three strands touched in rotation, woven together only in the final block

items.name: Spiral
items.cadence_note: the same question revisited at three depths, paragraphs shrinking each pass

items.name: Ledger
items.cadence_note: paired claim/cost paragraphs, symmetric until one claim goes unpaired

items.name: Wave
items.cadence_note: uniform lengths as camouflage — all variation lives in sentence cadence, alternating periodic and staccato within paragraphs

items.name: Trapdoor
items.cadence_note: even paragraphs; the last sentence of the second-to-last paragraph changes everything; the final paragraph lives in the aftermath

items.name: Overture
items.cadence_note: opening touches every theme briefly; the rest develops them out of order

items.name: Long Corridor
items.cadence_note: single-minded linear build, no digressions; the door opens sideways in the final lines

items.name: Eddy
items.cadence_note: linear flow with one paragraph that explicitly re-reads an earlier one

items.name: Counterweight
items.cadence_note: every assertion followed by a shorter counter — until one assertion goes unanswered

items.name: Cold Open
items.cadence_note: starts mid-argument as if the reader missed a page; context backfills

items.name: Descent
items.cadence_note: abstract opening, each paragraph more concrete, ending on a single instance carrying the whole weight

items.name: Ascent
items.cadence_note: concrete incident, each paragraph a level up in abstraction

items.name: Newsroom
items.cadence_note: six working paragraphs, two of them a single sentence carrying a fact, a remark or the turn; the short ones carry substance, never flourishes

items.name: Short Takes
items.cadence_note: seven compact paragraphs in an explainer register; each does one job and hands on
